Les dossiers Linux accessibles depuis Wi: Linux folders accessible from Windows, and the Linux folders where Windows saves its documents.
Chaque dossier apparaît comme un lecteur: Each folder shows up as a drive in Windows File Explorer and in the apps' “Open” and “Save” dialogs.
Relié, un dossier de Windows est le doss: Once linked, a Windows folder is the Linux folder of the same name: “Save” in Word offers ~/Documents, the Windows browser downloads to ~/Downloads. A Linux folder that is not shared yet gets shared along the way. What the Windows folders already held stays in Windows.
